jobs.role: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, AI Predictive Solutions
bullets: Contributed to prototyping and scaling ML systems for customer engagement prediction and promotional content personalization; staged rollout showed stronger performance than existing organic and event-driven strategies, supporting deployment across the U.S. portfolio and $9M in annual marketing spend.

Field Engagement Recommendation: Participated in developing uplift modeling framework to estimate the effect of field reach on customers' conversion and usage frequency, built regional optimization algorithms with feedback loop to automate weekly field engagement recommendations; scaled the solution to 6 product lines with development tailored to each product's market landscape and sales structure.

Model Evaluation Framework: Designed the model evaluation framework for the orchestration system, combining time-based offline validation, uplift evaluation (Qini/AUUC), and calibration checks with online holdout and A/B testing, using opt-outs as a guardrail metric to support model release decisions.

Digital Engagement Orchestration: Architected the next-generation digital orchestration system, decoupling channel delivery from uplift modeling and leveraging a shared-bottom multi-task DCN-v2 framework; integrated multi-funnel objectives (clicks/opens, site engagement, and rep follow-up success) to enable robust upper-funnel estimation and facilitate content selection.

Content Exploration & Cold-Start Solution: In support of the AI Content Hub, designed SBERT subject-line embeddings, ID embeddings, and a Thompson sampling bandit framework to address cold start problems and enable exploration of new content, allowing new content to be tested and activated efficiently within the existing digital orchestration system.

MLOps & Infra: Collaborated with the AI Infra team to continuously improve repo tooling: introduced Dagster for pipeline orchestration, Databricks MLflow for experiment tracking, and Lakehouse Monitoring, while enhancing unit and integration test robustness. Established repo-level agent usage guidelines and Skills following enterprise Claude adoption.

Developed in-house causal inference toolkits for customer- and geo-level campaign efficacy measurement. The toolkit supported six H2 2023 analyses and remains in use and is maintained by the team, reducing reliance on external vendors.

Standardized customer-level campaign evaluation with config-driven propensity-score matching and inverse-propensity weighting workflows that support multiple modeling algorithms for propensity scoring and automated statistical validation of covariate balance between test and control groups.

Automated geo-level campaign measurement that takes a campaign window and DMA list as input and outputs difference-in-differences and synthetic control estimates with pre-period fit diagnostics and plots.

Supported development of Experience Engine, an ML system that predicts member disengagement risk and content affinity; conducted feature selection and model benchmarking to inform final model selection.
